task_definition.description:
PRD: plans/merge-queue-reliability-prd.md task κ (scope 4) — ADDITIVE SUBSTRATE HALF. Depends on ι (2164, done).

⚠️ SCOPE NARROWED 2026-07-11 (/unblock, esc-2169-4 decompose disposition). κ was over-decomposed into 26 TDD steps and exhausted MAX_TURNS at step 12/26. Following the scope-exhaustion split precedent (cf. task 2357), κ is split at the additive|conversion seam:

  • THIS TASK (2169) delivers ONLY the ADDITIVE registry-population wiring (completed steps 1-12): ItemLifecycle registry (_lifecycle) instantiated on SpeculativeMergeWorker; a _live_items object index kept in lockstep; chokepoint helpers (_register_item / _note_transition / _retire_item / _note_requeue); and register()/transition() wired at every put/pop across the 5 containers (merger-drain QUEUED→LANE_BUFFERED→MERGING, merger→verifier handoff, verifier dispatch-fill DISPATCHING, verify→finalize FINALIZING/GATE_REVERIFY/TERMINAL, terminal/drain sites). The 4 transient side-fields are RETAINED and still drive all behaviour (additive, behaviour-preserving; _note_transition is best-effort-loud and never raises on the hot path). The registry is PROVEN to agree with the field-based snapshot census (test_merge_queue_lifecycle_registry.py step-11 wiring-completeness proof: full multi-item pipeline + stop-mid-flight, registry non-terminal set == snapshot()['entries'] census, no leaks).

  • The SINGLE-READ CONVERSION — repoint snapshot()/liveness onto the registry as single reads, DELETE the 4 transient fields (_inflight_req/_remerging_item/_finalizing_head/_dispatching_item), and add PRD boundary test B8 (snapshot/audit/liveness provably agree) — moves to a FOLLOW-ON task ("W1 κ-b: single-read conversion", depends on this task). κ's ORIGINAL user-observable signal is delivered by κ-b, not this task. Consumer λ's real prereq is κ-b.

NEW SIGNAL (this task): the ItemLifecycle registry is populated in lockstep at every put/pop across the 5 containers; the step-11 wiring-completeness proof is green — the registry's non-terminal census equals the field-based snapshot census across a full pipeline run + stop-mid-flight (no leaks, no spurious illegal-transition escalations). Landed additively on main (rebased clean onto current main; 828 merge-queue tests green; no field removals, no reader repoints).
